prompt: A 12-slide deck navigated with the arrow keys; Home returns to slide 1. Slide numbers shown bottom-right. The entry file is `main.eligian` in the current directory. Every slide is its own timeline, named `slide-1` to `slide-12`, running in the container `#deck`; the deck starts on `slide-1`. ArrowRight goes to the next slide, ArrowLeft to the previous one, Home to `slide-1`; declare the keys with `on key` on each slide timeline, without `in`, so they listen on `#deck`. Use these element ids: `#slide-1` to `#slide-12` (each visible only while its timeline is active) and `#counter` (the slide number, whose text is exactly `<n> / 12`, for example `4 / 12`). An element counts as hidden when it or an ancestor has the `hidden` attribute or computes `display: none`, `visibility: hidden` or `opacity: 0` from your CSS; otherwise it is visible.
